items.text: Telltale's instruction letter requires the General Counsel (Marguerite Salvesen) to discuss any proposed testifying expert before anyone is signed, and to receive fee quotes before engagement. Clear any proposed expert with her first, because expert fees are the largest budget swing item.

Telltale's regulatory affairs group (under Odalys Fennimore) must read every defense expert report before service to check consistency with regulatory submissions. Allow two weeks for this review. Comments go through counsel to the expert, not directly.

Telltale wants nothing about its settlement thinking or claims reserve to reach a mediator or anyone outside the case team. Reserve figures are for the team only. The client must approve any mediator before the firm agrees, and the firm should confirm that mediation is confidential and cannot be used against Telltale in other cases.

Telltale defends several ArcLine cases and wants no material from one case to appear in any other. Keep each matter's confidential discovery materials, mediation statements, settlement numbers, strategy and work product separate. Do not share them with other Telltale counsel unless the General Counsel asks, and confirm in writing who on the team has access.

Telltale reporting and handling requirements (from the engagement letter): a monthly written status report of no more than three pages on the first business day of each month; a call within two business days of any court ruling or key-witness deposition; a full liability and damages assessment within 60 days of engagement; and a week's notice before filing any motion except in emergencies. Draft stipulations go to the General Counsel before they are sent. All communications go to the GC, with insurance liaison Thaddeus Wren copied on anything touching coverage or exposure.

Telltale constraints: contact Telltale employees only through the General Counsel's office, and do not approach treating physicians or other providers without her approval. Observe any litigation hold. Staff matters with no more than three lawyers. Invoice monthly using client task codes. Work above the approved phase budget needs prior approval. Plan two-hour preparation sessions with field clinical engineers and the reliability group before depositions. Show the GC proposed corporate-representative topics, and do not offer manufacturing-floor witnesses without speaking to her.
Telltale's self-insured retention is $1,200,000 per claim, and the excess carrier must be notified above that. Thaddeus Wren handles the notice.

Telltale asked that settlement hints from opposing counsel be acknowledged politely and kept out of any correspondence not marked as a settlement communication. Mark any settlement-related correspondence accordingly, and do not let such overtures pass through ordinary discovery email threads.
